dimensions.note: apiKey is .meta({ sensitive: true }) and the README creates the instance with vault.get. The key goes only in the x-api-key or authorization header, never in errors, logs or stored data (a test checks the logs).
Both methods log at info on entry (model and attempt limit, or base URL) and on completion (attempts, token counts and data name, or model count), with structured placeholders only.

Every failure throws before writeResource. HTTP errors carry the status and the body's message. Answer-shape failures are retried with feedback; 429/503 are retried after Retry-After; other HTTP errors are thrown at once (tested: HTTP 500 is not retried).

36 tests with an injected fetch and sleep: both routes, the GPT refusal, HTTP errors, truncated or missing answers, non-JSON, schema retries with feedback, the attempt limit, reserved names, logging, rate-limit waits and their cap.
No remote resources are created. ask is a query whose answer varies by nature; a rerun stores a new version. Nothing is left half-written when it fails.

Responses are read defensively (optional chaining, missing usage becomes 0, catalogue ids filtered to strings). 429 and 503 honour numeric Retry-After (1s default, 30s cap, three tries in all). Zen's /models is not paginated.
Each response body is read in full with res.text(), including retried ones, and AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs) bounds every request. No files or temporary state.
README and tests use the public Zen URL, generic model ids and fake keys. No hostnames, IPs or account ids.
All schemas are plain z.object with no passthrough. Answer.json is z.unknown on purpose: the caller's JSON Schema validates it.
answer: infinite, keep 20 versions. catalog: infinite, keep 5.
Not a CRUD lifecycle behavior; it queries an API.
No method mutates a remote resource.
Each method writes one instance. ask refuses latest (swamp's) and catalog (the models method's), so the two specs never share a data name.
The type is new (@puddleworks/opencode, renamed from the unpublished @mesgme/opencode) and model.version is unchanged with no schema change, so no upgrade entry is needed.
